#### 1. amyloidosis, hereditary systemic 3  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.442)

Mutations in APOE and APOA1 impair lipid metabolism, leading to the accumulation of lipid droplets and subsequent histiocytosis (sea-blue histiocyte syndrome). These same genetic defects also disrupt proteostasis, causing the accumulation and aggregation of misfolded proteins, resulting in amyloidosis.

**How to falsify it:** Absence of mutations in APOE or APOA1 in individuals with sea-blue histiocyte syndrome, or the presence of mutations in these genes that do not demonstrably impair lipid metabolism or proteostasis. _(variant: Common variants (AF > 0.01) in APOE or APOA1 that are not known to be pathogenic for either disease.)_
